Task: Port the OAuth module from TypeScript to Python for step 2.14 of the pycortex migration.

**Source files to port:**
- `/Users/sachinkoli/github/hoocode/packages/ai/src/utils/oauth/types.ts` - OAuth types
- `/Users/sachinkoli/github/hoocode/packages/ai/src/utils/oauth/anthropic.ts` - Anthropic OAuth
- `/Users/sachinkoli/github/hoocode/packages/ai/src/utils/oauth/github-copilot.ts` - GitHub Copilot OAuth
- `/Users/sachinkoli/github/hoocode/packages/ai/src/utils/oauth/openai-codex.ts` - OpenAI Codex OAuth
- `/Users/sachinkoli/github/hoocode/packages/ai/src/utils/oauth/pkce.ts` - PKCE helpers
- `/Users/sachinkoli/github/hoocode/packages/ai/src/utils/oauth/oauth-page.ts` - OAuth page
- `/Users/sachinkoli/github/hoocode/packages/ai/src/utils/oauth/index.ts` - Main exports and registry

**Target location:** `/Users/sachinkoli/github/pycortex/packages/ai/oauth/src/cortex/ai/oauth/`

**Requirements:**
1. Mechanical port following conventions in `.hoocode/MIGRATION_NOTES.md`
2. Create `types.py`, `anthropic.py`, `github_copilot.py`, `openai_codex.py`, `pkce.py`, `oauth_page.py`, `__init__.py`
3. Tests should go in `/Users/sachinkoli/github/pycortex/packages/ai/oauth/tests/`
4. Follow existing code style (google.py, anthropic.py patterns)
5. Use httpx for HTTP requests (not SDKs)
6. Run `uv run ruff check` and `uv run ruff format --check` after implementation

**Key considerations:**
- OAuth token storage uses file system
- PKCE flow for authorization
- Token refresh logic
- Provider registry pattern (same as api_registry.py)

After implementation, run:
- `uv run pytest packages/ai/oauth`
- `uv run ruff check packages/ai/oauth`
- `uv run ruff format --check packages/ai/oauth`
- `uv run pyright packages/ai/oauth`
